scope: Five assembled prototype A boards and five assembled temperature B boards for quotation; not an order
surface_finish: ENIG requested; any alternative requires approval

assembly.process_B: Standard candidate, measured LM2596 package peak <=245C; factory thermal profile approval mandatory
assembly.moisture: Handle each actual MSL lot correctly; LM2596 and Kingbright LEDs include MSL3 parts
assembly.extra_sockets: Two Harwin M20-7821546 under A/U1; nominal finished holes1.05mm; 25.4mm row centres, 2.54mm pitch
assembly.loose_shunt: One Harwin M7566-05 per A, supplied loose; do not bridge JP1 at delivery
assembly.customer_module: Do not buy or solder the removable ESP32 DevKit
assembly.net_tie: B/NT1 copper only; no purchased part
assembly.substitutions: No automatic manufacturer, package or value substitutions

panelization.owner: Assembler, proposal and DFM approval before build
panelization.protect_clip_contact_areas: Top/bottom4mm bands and side1.5mm supports; no tabs, tooling holes or permanent rails in these areas

inspection.bare_board_electrical_test: Request100% opens/shorts test using supplied bare_board_test.d356; B PGND/GND physically equivalent through NT1
inspection.assembly: AOI plus THT/polarity inspection; confirm LM2596 tab solder process/inspection
inspection.functional_quote: factory_acceptance_test.md; no ESP32 firmware and no heater attached
inspection.traceability: Record actual fitted MPNs, authorized substitutions if any, test results and lot identification
